text:
[issue by BriegelDerBusch]
First time reporting an issue on github so I am sorry in advance.

Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
Launched Version: neoforge-21.1.194

I wanted to update my modpack and ran into issues. As far as I could isolate the problem the crash posted below started appearing when just updating owo via curseforge. I was trying to load a singleplayer map.

It seems owo somehow loads accessories-neoforge-1.1.0-beta.34+1.21.1.jar into the load-order, which itself tries to call net/fabricmc/fabric/api/networking/v1/PlayerLookup


Minecraft Crashlog:
https://gist.github.com/BriegelDerBusch/3abad9e17b8d90fafff49a432b1f5caa

[comment by Noaaan (member)]
This is a duplicate of https://github.com/wisp-forest/accessories/issues/301, and already fixed in newer versions of Accessories

[comment by BriegelDerBusch (none)]
I am very sorry for bothering in this case.
